publication.release_notes: Separate equipment catalog research and administration into Grid Catalog. Main Grid retains production, budgeting, finance, contacts, companies, locations, schedules, talent and document workflows. Remove the equipment catalog research skill from this package. Preserve the existing MCP URL and published app connection; the matching server release makes its default discovery and dispatch use the Production filter (390 operations), while the separate Catalog endpoint retains 88 operations including shared dependencies. Reviewer credentials remain in secure dashboard fields.
